name: Ask To Set Etsy Shop Texts
description: Ask to set the Etsy shop's title, announcement, messages to buyers after a purchase and additional policies, and to add shop sections. Nothing changes until the owner reads the full new texts and approves; only what differs is sent. Etsy's API has no About section.
requires: the owner's commerce_etsy_enabled and commerce_etsy_shop_write_enabled switches
an Etsy connection made with shop edits (shops_w)
the owner's approval of each change
